item.title: ‘HEADS EXAMINING,’ O’NEILL FURY AT CELTIC PROTESTERS
item.description: A FURIOUS Martin O’Neill raged at a section of Celtic fans following the team’s dismal, mistake-riddled 4-1 Europa League first leg play-off loss to VfB Stuttgart at Parkhead. item.title: ‘KEEP FIGHTING,’ McGREGOR’S WAR CRY
